展开英文原题摘要与原文链接
ABSTRACT（原文，未删改）
Pathogenic variants in the exonuclease (proofreading) domain of DNA polymerase {varepsilon} (POLE) are frequently detected in colorectal cancers (CRC) with high tumor mutational burden (TMB), yet their functional role in intestinal tumorigenesis remains unknown. Here, we investigated the impact of mutation in POLE on intestinal homeostasis using a conditional mouse model expressing the PoleP286R pathogenic driver in intestinal epithelial cells. PoleP286R mutant mice developed invasive adenocarcinomas in the small intestine with incomplete penetrance and extremely long latency but did not spontaneously develop colorectal tumors. However, induction of colitis with dextran sodium sulfate (DSS) resulted in a striking phenotypic shift to colorectal adenocarcinomas at high frequency. Molecular and histological analyses revealed hyperactivation of Wnt/{beta}-catenin, NF-{kappa}B, ERK and STAT3 pathways, accompanied by markedly higher proliferation of intestinal epithelial cells, in DSS-treated PoleP286R mutant mouse colons. Whole genome sequencing of the tumor demonstrated exceptionally high TMB (>100 mutations/megabase) and characteristic trinucleotide signatures, consistent with human POLE tumors. Recurrent mutations in Apc and Ctnnb1 underscored the central role of Wnt signaling in POLE-driven hypermutated CRC. In addition, intestinal organoids derived from PoleP286R mutant mice exhibited accelerated growth and increased expression of pro-proliferative genes. Together, these findings highlight POLE as a gatekeeper of intestinal genomic integrity and identify inflammation as the key driver that unleashes POLE-mutant CRC. Furthermore, this work establishes a mechanistically faithful preclinical platform for studying the molecular pathogenesis of CRC and advancing therapeutic drug discovery.

Pyruvate partitioning defines an immunosuppressive metabolic niche in colorectal cancer

意义与启示：该研究揭示丙酮酸分配在CRC细胞和空间上组织化，低PPI形成髓系-基质免疫抑制微环境，且MSI肿瘤PPI最低，提示代谢干预联合免疫治疗需考虑癌种特异性。
展开英文原题摘要与原文链接
ABSTRACT（原文，未删改）
Purpose. Colorectal cancer (CRC) reprograms glucose metabolism, diverting pyruvate from mitochondrial oxidation toward lactate export. How this partitioning decision is organized across cell types and tissue space, and how it relates to immune programmes, remains unresolved. Methods. We defined a Pyruvate Partitioning Index (PPI) as the difference between an oxidative arm (MPC1, MPC2, PDHA1, PDHB, DLAT, DLD, PDHX) and an export arm (LDHA, LDHB, SLC16A1, SLC16A3, SLC16A7), and computed it across TCGA COADREAD (n = 592), GSE39582 (n = 579), two single-cell atlases (370,115 and 63,689 cells), 13 Visium sections and an exploratory urothelial immunotherapy cohort (IMvigor210, n = 298). Results. PPI was lowest in microsatellite-unstable (MSI) tumours (Mann-Whitney p = 3.8 x 10^-9) and inversely associated with overall survival (log-rank p = 1.2 x 10^-4). Epithelial cells were the most oxidative compartment (median +0.058) and myeloid cells the most export-prone (-0.171; Kruskal p [~] 0), reproduced independently; MMRd epithelium was intrinsically export-shifted (-0.012 vs +0.076 vs +0.192 for MMRd, MMRp and normal). Spatially, PPI was non-random (Moran's I significant in 12/13 sections), with low-PPI spots enriched for SPP1+ macrophages, myofibroblasts and plasma cells, but not CD8+ T-cell factors. Low-PPI tumours showed coordinated increases in immune-checkpoint, myeloid and Treg programmes (checkpoint rho = -0.262), and network perturbation identified LDHA as the hub. Conclusions. Pyruvate partitioning is cellularly and spatially organized in CRC and defines a myeloid-stromal immunosuppressive niche. Because MSI tumours (the best CRC immunotherapy responders) had the lowest PPI, the PPI-response relationship appears cancer-type specific and requires validation in CRC cohorts.

ABSTRACT（原文，未删改）
Colorectal cancer (CRC) represents the third leading cause of cancer related deaths worldwide and is influenced by multiple risk factors. Both exposure to microbiota as well as adaptive immune responses have been implicated in CRC development and suggested as candidate biomarkers. However, the extent to which CRC and adenomas associate with systemic immune signatures against microbes remains unclear. Here, we apply Phage-display ImmunoPrecipitation Sequencing (PhIP-Seq) on 321 individuals of an Austrian CORSA cohort (Colorectal Cancer Study of Austria) including controls, adenomas, and CRC patients. Although antibody repertoires showed global similarity across the different disease status and limited predictive performance, prevalence-based analyses revealed specific signals, such as Helicobacter pylori CagY as candidate marker of CRC and viral antigens as candidate for non-cancer stages. Taken together, this large-scale analysis of antibody reactivity in CRC highlights the potential of serological markers to reflect disease-associated immune signatures.

Metabolite-centric Knowledge Graph Unveils Predictive and Mechanistic Insights through Self-supervised Multimodal Learning

意义与启示：MetaKG整合多模态数据构建代谢物知识图谱，在结直肠癌中验证其预测与机制发现能力，为肠癌代谢标志物与治疗靶点研究提供新工具。
展开英文原题摘要与原文链接
ABSTRACT（原文，未删改）
Metabolomics research is advancing toward a comprehensive view of metabolites and their biological functions, yet conventional, dictionary-like databases fall short of presenting these complexities. To overcome this limitation, we developed MetaKG, a metabolite-centric knowledge graph that integrates diverse chemical, biological, and semantic data, coupled with a global self-supervised multimodal learning framework that generates advanced embeddings (MetaKGE) for both predictive and mechanistic analyses. MetaKG outperforms existing models in standard representation learning metrics and across 12 external datasets. Furthermore, MetaKG refines existing database information by detecting misannotated labels and uncovering previously overlooked biochemical relationships. Its predictive capability naturally yields testable biochemical hypotheses, as demonstrated in studies of G6PD deficiency and colorectal cancer. By transforming passive, database-scale information into extractable knowledge and actionable insights, MetaKG paves the way for hypothesis-driven discovery in metabolomics and holds promise for informing future research in clinical biomarker identification and therapeutic development.

国际专家共识：下一代结直肠癌风险预测的核心自报变量
Core Self-Reported Variables for Next-Generation Colorectal Cancer Risk Prediction: An International Expert Consensus Study.
Cancer Medicine · 2026-10 · Dubois H, Torbjörnsson E, Norrbom J, Hubbard A, Enskär M, Phillips RV, et al.
要点与启示：通过改良德尔菲法确立23项自报变量，为结直肠癌风险分层筛查提供标准化输入，有望提升传统与机器学习模型的预测一致性。
展开英文原题摘要与原文链接
ABSTRACT（原文，未删改）
Colorectal cancer remains a major global health burden, and although population-based screening is beneficial, current programs have notable limitations. Risk-stratified screening has been proposed, yet existing prediction models vary in performance and in the inclusion of predictors. Data-adaptive modeling (machine learning) may strengthen risk prediction but depends on high-quality input data. Expert consensus methods offer a structured way to identify clinically meaningful variables for future tools. To establish expert consensus on the selection of relevant variables and refinement of self-reported questionnaire items for next-generation colorectal cancer risk-prediction tools. A modified Delphi study was conducted with seventeen internationally recognized experts. The process consisted of anonymized, email-based rounds aimed at refining a questionnaire for colorectal cancer risk prediction. Across three iterative rounds, experts rated item relevance, proposed revisions, and identified missing domains while reviewing group-level summaries of ratings and comments. Items not meeting predefined thresholds were removed, and validated lifestyle-related items were incorporated. Consensus was defined as 15 of 17 experts rating an item within a similar three-point range. All seventeen experts completed all rounds. The final I-CRC-RISK Questionnaire comprises 23 items across seven categories: Demography, Health Status, Family Health History, Dietary Patterns, Physical Activity, Smoking, and Alcohol Consumption. Expert consensus was reached for 19 items. The I-CRC-RISK Questionnaire provides an expert-informed set of self-reported variables to support future risk prediction efforts. It offers a structured basis for further validation and psychometric testing before prospective data collection may be undertaken. This foundational work could enhance the predictive performance of both traditional and machine-learning approaches by improving the consistency and relevance of input data.

本周热点与趋势总结

由本期文献提炼的课题组可执行信号
  1. 肝转移外科策略：EMBORES 2期试验（EClinicalMedicine）评估可吸收材料行临时选择性门静脉栓塞（PVE）在大范围肝切除前诱导未来肝残余（FLR）增生，提示以短暂门静脉阻断替代永久栓塞可在保留后续治疗选择的同时实现临床相关再生；该策略对结直肠癌肝转移（CRLM）转化切除与二期切除路径具有直接意义，但需关注再生效率与术后肝衰竭发生率的平衡。
  2. II期肠癌风险分层：Journal of Pathology: Clinical Research 提出“zero-budding”状态的分子病理基础与临床应用，指出传统TNM对II期CRC术后复发分层不足、辅助化疗决策存在困境，而肿瘤出芽（TB）虽已纳入指南作为侵袭性独立预后标志，现行ITBCC分级仍存在局限；零出芽表型有望成为豁免或强化辅助治疗的新分层依据，需前瞻性验证其与复发风险（HR）及化疗获益交互。
  3. 放疗靶区勾画智能化：Medical Physics 基于优化SAM构建提示引导交互式勾画流程，纳入100例直肠癌新辅助放疗病例（60训练/40测试），以bounding-box提示辅助GTV分割；结果支持该工作流在保持勾画效率的同时贴近医师手工轮廓，为直肠癌新辅助放疗的靶区标准化与批量质控提供工具，后续需在多中心数据上验证泛化性与观察者间一致性。
  4. 机制与转化靶点：Journal of Biochemical and Molecular Toxicology 报道XDH在CRC中下调，过表达可抑制增殖与侵袭并通过调控铁蛋白自噬（ferritinophagy）信号发挥作用，体内实验验证其抑瘤效应；该轴将嘌呤代谢酶与铁死亡相关通路连接，为CRC（含肝转移）提供潜在预后标志与干预靶点，尚需在CRLM模型中验证其对转移定植的影响。
  5. 内镜质控与筛查体系：Australian Health Review 论证澳大利亚建立全国结肠镜临床质量登记库的必要性，指出Colonoscopy Clinical Care Standard仅支持本地监测关键质量指标，无法判断变异是孤立、系统性还是集中于特定机构，形成国家层面盲区；该议题对肠癌筛查与癌前病变检出率的持续改进具有政策意义，也提示以登记库数据支撑质量基准与再认证。
  6. 整体趋势研判：本周证据呈现“局部治疗降创伤化（临时PVE）、病理分子精细分层（zero-budding）、AI辅助放疗流程化、代谢-铁蛋白自噬机制外延、以及内镜质控体系化”五条主线；对CRLM而言，核心矛盾正从“能否切除”转向“以可逆、可序贯的方式实现安全切除并保留后续治疗窗口”，建议关注临时PVE与转化治疗、二期切除策略的联合研究设计。
